... So if she catches us red-handed, Nelly might give us the super sleepy smack.
……所以要是我们被耐莉发现的话，这次真的会吃她一记超级安眠拳的。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Gardens of an Uncertain Time
某个时刻的呼啸山庄 庭院

dataList.content:
Besides, the front gate has got to be closed and locked by now.
还有，现在正门肯定也关上了。

This is...
这里是……

Now, ready?
来，准备好了吗？

Ready for... what?
要准备……什么？

My, Heathcliff! Didn't I tell you to pay attention when I'm speaking?
哎呀。希斯克利夫，我不是说过听我说话的时候要集中注意吗！

Ready to race from the top of that hill to the gardens?
从那个山丘上跑到庭院里，让我们比比谁先到吧？

I'll win this time, I'm sure of it.
我这次一定会赢。

But Cathy... you don't have your shoes.
凯茜……但你……没有穿鞋。

Heh, I suppose Nelly will have to lecture me, then. Doesn't matter, though!
嘿，耐莉又要生气了。算了，反正也没关系。

Oh! See that magnificent house over there?! Why don't we head over there and peek through its windows? I want to see who lives in such a big house.
啊！能看到那里有一座很大的房子吧？从窗户里看看那里都住着什么人吧。

Cathy, we can't...
不可以……凯茜……

Why not?
为什么？

Because...
那是因为……

If we go there now... they'll spot us...
如果现在去那座房子的话……我们肯定会被发现的……

... and sic their monstrously large hounds on us.
很大的狗会来追我们的。

One of them will bite your ankle. You won't scream, but...
然后其中的一只会咬到你的脚踝……虽然你没有叫出声，但是……

... you'll bleed a lot. Enough to keep your wound bandaged for weeks. I regretted it, day and night, that it should've been me who was mauled in your place.
你会流很多血。需要好几周都缠着绷带。我不分昼夜地后悔，应该由我来代你受伤。

... And?
……然后呢？

The people in that house will take you inside to dress your wounds...
那座房子里出来的人把你带回他们家治疗之后……

... and there, you'll meet... Linton...
你就会遇见……林顿……

How did you feel about that?
你的感受如何呢？

Everyone was entranced the moment they saw you... Of course they were. Because you are the most beautiful person in the world.
大家都对你着迷了……这是当然。因为你比世上的任何人都要美丽。

But... Heathcliff.
但是……希斯克利夫。

You left me behind in that manor.
你不是丢下我先行离开那座宅邸了吗。

My heart sank to its deepest depths. Then, instead of hitting rock bottom, it kept sinking.
感觉我的心脏都落入了谷底。

Now that I think about it, I felt... wretched. Miserable.
我之后想了想，感觉与那心情最为接近的一词是“悲惨”。

I was angry that you hurt your ankles. I hated that I wasn't a part of that posh picture with you and the others. But more than anything, I...
我很生气你伤了脚踝，也很讨厌我不属于那高贵绘画一般的光景……但最重要的是……

... felt that we could no longer be together... ever again.
我初次感受到……你和我……再也不能在一起了。

That incident really drew Hindley's ire. So he ordered Nelly to completely neglect your care.
因为这件事，亨德利哥哥对你勃然大怒。他还命令让耐莉完全不理你。

I stayed at this manor for five weeks... grew closer to Linton and his little sister Isabella...
然后我在那座宅邸住了五个星期……和林顿……还有他妹妹伊莎贝拉都成了好朋友……

... It was the stay which, eventually, became the reason you denied me for the first time.
结果……这成了你第一次拒绝我的理由。

My life until this moment... they were the happiest times of my life. It was all I ever wanted.
直到这一瞬间前……我的人生都无比幸福。

But I must leave now. Because this is but a diary of mine.
但是，我必须走了。因为这只是我的日记而已。

You can't change the past.
已经发生的事情无法改变吧。

I... I still cherished this day. The day I could run so freely across the gardens by your side...
尽管如此……我也仍喜欢那一天。那能与你一起在庭院中尽情奔跑的一天……

I did too, Heathcliff.
我也是，希斯克利夫。

That is why I wrote my diary. So that I will hold these memories to eternity's end.
所以为了能永远记住，我在日记本中密密麻麻地写满了……

My... most precious memories...
我……最珍贵的记忆……
